data.name: Anahita
data.gender_notes: Anahita is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In ancient Persian mythology, Anahita was the goddess of water, fertility, and the protector of travellers. She was also considered the goddess of abundance, generosity, and good fortune. The name Anahita carries the meaning “Goddess of Water and Fertility” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian, Avestan. Parents who choose Anahita usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of water and fertility and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Anahita represents the divine feminine and the nurturing, life-giving force of water. She embodies the qualities of compassion, love, and abundance. Her spiritual meaning can inspire us to connect with the natural world, embrace the cycles of life, and cultivate inner peace and harmony.
data.etymology: Anahita belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Water and Fertility.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anahita total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Anahita holds a significant cultural impact in Persian mythology as it signifies the reverence for the natural element of water and the blessings it brings to life. Its association with fertility also highlights the importance of agriculture in ancient Persian culture and societies. Moreover, Anahita as the protector of travellers reflects the value placed on hospitality and shared kindness within communities.
data.spiritual_significance: Symbolically, the Islamic name Anahita carries spiritual depth as it embodies the essence of mercy, compassion, and grace that blesses all creation. Through its connection with water—a fundamental life force—the name signifies the grace and blessing of the divine upon humanity. Furthermore, its association with abundance, generosity, and good fortune illuminates the spiritual truth that the Divine provisions are boundless and bestows blessings upon all creation.
